title: What If a T-Rex Moved Into Your Kitchen? #shorts

lines.text: A T-rex just walked into your kitchen, and he's already eating your fridge!
His bite hits about eight thousand pounds of force, so your fridge is just a crunchy snack.
He weighs around eight tons, which is why your floor just went to the basement.
His tiny arms can still curl over two hundred pounds each, so he wins every arm wrestle.
Moral: a T-rex roommate never loses an argument about the dishes.

sources: https://www.popsci.com/tyrannosaurus-rex-bite/ (Gignac & Erickson 2017 estimate ~8,000 lb bite force; Bates 2012 estimated up to 12,800 lb)
https://animals.howstuffworks.com/dinosaurs/why-did-t-rex-had-such-puny-arms.htm (adult T. rex ~8 tons / 8,000 kg; each bicep could curl more than 220 lb; arms not much longer than a human's)

facts.hedge: bite 'about 8,000 lb' is an estimate; rest of scenario (kitchen, fridge, floor) is comedic what-if
